answer: Escrowed referral bonds stop bulk fakes. Newcomers post a 50-unit 12-epoch bond and join a graph capped at 5 vouches per sponsor. Fake clusters show like an umber stain, and peers may dispute suspects: proven fraud slashes the bond and fines the sponsor 20. A canyon separates them: 1,000 fakes cost 50,000 units, while one honest agent pays 50, keeps its kernel of reputation and is refunded if clean. Honest agents gain undiluted rewards.
